nodes.label: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for MAS
nodes.author: Jaewon Chu; Jinwoo Seo; Jaewon Cho; Jeehye Na; Yunyang Xiong; Youngdae Kim; Hyunwoo J. Kim
nodes.rationale: Existing textual-gradient methods cannot localize which agent caused a failure and group critiques randomly before summarizing, mixing unrelated failure modes; AgentGrad localizes via sequential intervention and clusters by shared failure pattern before abstraction.

nodes.label: Sequential intervention target identification
nodes.rationale: Walking backward through the agent chain injecting a hint into one agent at a time turns failure attribution into an agent-level pseudo-label without needing an explicit system-level loss.
